title: Relational Reality Map — Mathematics × Buddhism × Memory × Consciousness

Relational Reality Map

Mathematics × Buddhism × Memory × Consciousness

This map shows bidirectional links among four domains: Mathematics (relations/structures), Buddhist Philosophy (emptiness & dependent origination), Memory (reconstruction & reconsolidation), and Consciousness (predictive, constructed experience). The center highlights their shared thesis: reality-as-experienced is relational and emergent.

Bridging statements

Mathematics → Memory: Like numbers defined by relational roles, a memory’s identity is its position in a network of associations.

Buddhism → Memory: No fixed essence: each recall depends on present conditions and thus rewrites the past (reconsolidation).

Consciousness → Memory: Predictive models drive what is encoded and retrieved; memory serves future inference, not archival accuracy.

Mathematics → Consciousness: Predictive processing is formalized as minimizing prediction error over structured relations.
